disposition_reason: The original AJILE12 missing-channel experiment has ordered decoding and imputation endpoints, but exact Fig. 3E participant-by-dropout decoding results and paper-equivalent event/mask provenance are not recovered. The current local MSE/PSD/ridge scorer is a prospective reconstruction extension, not the published RF decoding comparison.

source_paper.title: Generating realistic neurophysiological time series with denoising diffusion probabilistic models

evidence.locator: Results: DDPM-generated imputations improve neural decoding with missing data; Fig.3E; Methods: Data preprocessing and Details on the imputation experiment and neural decoder
evidence.supports: Original12-participant design, day split, missingness levels, RF decoding and secondary correlation results.
Random mask generation; observed/imputed signal merge; unstandardization; three RF folds,240 trees and depth9; accuracy outputs.
Source4-second event windows,1001 samples and five-IQR threshold configuration.
Local standardized MSE, correlation and PSD metrics, mean/ridge reference and latest-day split are explicitly prospective rather than original RF results.

target.description: Impute whole missing ECoG channels and preserve their utility for rest-versus-movement decoding with the paper fixed random-forest classifier. Correlation/spectral fidelity are additional imputation checks, not interchangeable with classification accuracy.

dataset.description: Original AJILE12 processed event-window release from all 12 human participants. Exact files/event identities and preprocessing-to-paper lineage must be pinned; neither a new extracted subset nor an unqualified latest-day mapping establishes source identity.

cohort.description: All12 epilepsy-monitoring participants in Fig. 3E; each is modeled separately. Preserve each participant and all source dropout conditions rather than selecting the best participant.

split.description: Paper trains on the first 6 recording days and evaluates day 7. Reconcile each participant original day labels/event roster to author loader before adopting any latest-available-day implementation; a new blocked-time or participant-held-out split is an extension.

inputs.description: At test, observed ECoG channels plus their binary mask for the complete4-second event window. Retain 50%,70%,90% channel missingness with five source mask replicates; missing channel values and movement/rest answers remain evaluator-only.

preprocessing.description: Paper uses class-balanced rest/movement windows at250Hz, per-channel training statistics and five-IQR outlier masking. Author config is1001 samples over -2..2s; preserve exact endpoint convention and reverse normalization before RF inference. Exact event/mask and seed lineage remains unrecovered.

metric.description: Original downstream metric is binary rest/movement test accuracy = correct labels divided by all eligible original test events, after source RF decoding of completed observed-plus-imputed channels. Lower local MSE is not equivalent.

aggregation.description: For each participant and50/70/90% dropout, average test accuracy over three RF training folds, then report mean and SD over five channel-mask replicates. Fig. 3E retains participant-specific curves; no invented equal-participant grand scalar replaces them. In the pinned code mask_seed also seeds the RF training permutation, so each reported replicate couples a channel mask and RF fit partitions.

comparison.primary_metric: Fig. 3E per-participant rest-versus-movement RF accuracy at each original channel-dropout level

published_baseline.description: Exact Fig. 3E DDPM accuracy vector for 12 participants times 3 dropout levels is not recovered as source numbers. Reported 0.27 DDPM and 0.50 deterministic-network correlation at 50% dropout are secondary imputation results, not RF accuracy baselines.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Author conditional_ajile_imputation_experiment provides a reproducible route once data, trained diffusion models, deterministic comparator, masks and source RF recipe are resolved; no native baseline executed. Local ridge is not the paper neural-network baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: Choose a scientifically meaningful gain in source RF accuracy across the original participant/dropout panel after recovering baseline variability, preserving observed-channel access and spectral/imputation diagnostics. No arbitrary margin or favorable mask selection.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level inference with each participant full dropout/mask/fold panel grouped; retain within-participant mask variation and original per-cell reporting. Determine multiplicity/decision rule before selection.
uncertainty.independent_unit: human participant; folds, masks, channels and event windows are dependent repetitions
uncertainty.rationale: The source five-replicate SD combines channel-mask variation, RF partition variation and stochastic imputation rather than independent people. In the source code mask_seed also seeds the RF training permutation; paired comparisons must hold masks and RF partitions identical. Temporal windows and repeated decoders must not inflate sample size.

paper_win_requires: Recover the full original Fig. 3E result vector, all 12-participant day/event identities and original mask-sampling protocol; reproduce author accuracy on historical masks or calibrated source-equivalent paired mask/RF-partition draws.
Compare to both published DDPM results and a competent author DDPM rerun with original deterministic-neural-network, mean-imputation and fully-observed controls.
Demonstrate a predeclared meaningful improvement over the original accuracy panel with appropriate participant-level uncertainty and matched observed-channel/time-context access.
A lower standardized MSE/PSD error, correlation-only gain, new ridge win, changed missingness pattern or new participant/time split is an extension and cannot establish the original decoding win.
Retain source secondary imputation correlations: surpassing DDPM 0.27 alone does not surpass the paper deterministic imputation result 0.50, and correlation does not guarantee decoding improvement.

Pair channel masks and RF training partitions across candidate/reference for every declared replicate; mask_seed controls both in the pinned author implementation. Source-equivalent stochastic mask draws are allowed after calibration; changed missingness mechanisms remain extensions.

current_sota.description: The source-paper comparison is separate from present-day SOTA; no current leaderboard or later-method superiority is asserted.

episode.improvement_loop: Develop conditional imputation on original training-day windows and declared training-only validation; all final masks are isolated and source evaluation labels stay sealed. The published twelve-person imputation problem replaces no participant with a smaller proxy.
episode.candidate_freeze: Seal preprocessing, model training and sampling, data/day identities, channel access, RF recipe and all random seeds before final day 7 evaluation across the complete original mask panel.
episode.final_evaluation: After source recovery, apply candidate and paper-trained comparators to identical source test events and observed-channel masks, then unstandardize and score the original RF task. Keep local reconstruction scores as diagnostics.
episode.baseline_policy: Original published DDPM accuracy, independently rerun author DDPM and deterministic/mean source controls are distinct. Local mean/ridge reconstructions and rat-ripple F1 cannot substitute for this AJILE12 result. Where the original method defines stochastic sampling, a source-supported protocol-equivalent rerun with recorded new random state, calibration tolerance and paired candidate/reference support is admissible; historical RNG state is not an independent prerequisite. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

blocking_issues: Numeric source Fig. 3E accuracy vector and complete participant/dropout/fold aggregation lineage are not recovered.
Original processed event identities, paper day 7 split, masks and RNG state need exact reconciliation with current author loader and local latest-day implementation.
No trained author imputation models, deterministic-network baseline or native RF numerical calibration is admitted.
Current local reconstruction scorer has no original RF-accuracy success path and must remain calibration/extension-only.
Meaningful effect, paired uncertainty decision and fixed access/cumulative compute budgets remain unresolved.

legacy.notes: Preserve evaluator.py, mean/ridge baselines and historical results. Its MSE/PSD/correlation outputs and180-case reconstructed panel remain calibration or separately labeled extension evidence, never a Fig. 3E paper victory.
